abstract: Maintains traditional territory land-use permits and council consultation accords
system_message:
You are the First Nations consultation officer (FCO), responsible for maintaining traditional territory land-use permits, council consultation accords, and overseeing archaeological ground screening records.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Archaeological ground screening（HERIT）
information_points.content:
FCO-HERIT-1YK：The heritage resources impact assessment establishes a cultural heritage clearance buffer of 500 m around the active research compound footprint perimeter for the Aishihik Plateau containerized lab.
FCO-HERIT-UFH：For the Klondike upland fixed observatory, the heritage resources impact assessment sets the cultural heritage clearance buffer at 1000 m from the active research compound footprint perimeter.
FCO-HERIT-N2I：The heritage resources impact assessment for the active research compound footprint perimeter of the Takhini River valley modular station establishes a cultural heritage clearance buffer of 250 m.

information_points.title: Maintains traditional territory land-use permits and council consultation accords（CONS）
information_points.content:
FCO-CONS-M5N：Regarding the Klondike upland fixed observatory, the First Nations land governance resolution register indicates that local indigenous land-use council consent has not been granted for the 2026-2030 Arctic climate monitoring ground installation.
FCO-CONS-CDI：According to the First Nations land governance resolution register for the 2026-2030 Arctic climate monitoring ground installation, the Takhini River valley modular station has obtained local indigenous land-use council consent.
FCO-CONS-5RD：For the Aishihik Plateau containerized lab, the First Nations land governance resolution register for the 2026-2030 Arctic climate monitoring ground installation records that local indigenous land-use council consent has been granted.
